name: skyline-escape
description: Free-running parkour chase game for web and mobile. All content unlocked, free.

scripts.android:init: npm install && npx cap add android && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.android:build: npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.ios:init: npm install && npx cap add ios && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
